comment: Query and candidate pairs that fix the order both palette matchers must agree on. The frontend suite reads this file through rank.ts and the Rust suite reads it through GameIndex::search. `expect` is the exact order the query returns, and `reject` names paths the query must not return at all.

cases.name: a name the query opens outranks one that only holds it
a term opening a word outranks the same term buried inside one
a name match outranks a match that reaches the directory
equal scores put the shorter path first
every term of a query has to appear
a query is a run of characters and not a subsequence of a path
